entry.summary:
For the first time since her tamariki were found, Cat Christey speaks about rebuilding her life after years of trauma | Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?sub_confirmation=1

She reflects on her relationship with Tom Phillips and the challenges of dealing with the agencies involved in her whānau's case.

Full story: https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/crime-and-justice/847951/he-was-a-dictator-mother-of-marokopa-children-speaks-out-about-her-relationship-with-tom-phillips
